senses.gloss: (II)--a mind-born son of ब्रह्मा in the १५थ् kalpa. वा. २१. ३५.

--son of Pulastya; initiated into ज्ञान by ऋभु. Engaged himself in austerities for a thousannd years in a grove in वीरनगर on the banks of the देविका. After this period at the time of taking meals, ऋभु appeared before him, but was not recognised. Being requested for meals, ऋभु agreed on condition that he would be served with sweet viands. After meals, he found that he was his old master, and was overjoyed. He went away, and नीदाघ continued his austerities for another १००० years. At the end [page२-256+ ३३] of this period ऋभु appeared and saw him standing aloof from a crowd witnessing the king riding on his elephant. ऋभु asked him who was the king and who was the elephant. निदाघ said that the man above was king and that below the elephant. ऋभु asked him what he meant by above and below. Little knowing that he was his master, नीदाघ jumped on him and remarked he was above and ऋभु below. Finding that नीदाघ had not attained full maturity in अद्वैत, ऋभु once again initiated him and departed. From that day नीदाघ looked upon anything without any distinc- tion. Vi. II. chh. १५ and १६.
